# Pull Request

## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Notes/content
- [ ] UI/layout
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Tooling/config
- [ ] Documentation

## Testing

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Checked responsive layout, if UI changed
- [ ] Checked relevant note pages in the browser

## Screenshots

Add screenshots for UI changes.

## Checklist

- [ ] I did not push directly to `main`.
- [ ] This PR targets `main`.
- [ ] The change is focused and reviewable.
- [ ] I updated related docs or notes if needed.
- [ ] I did not commit `.next/`, `out/`, or `node_modules/`.
- [ ] I avoided unrelated formatting or refactors.

## Risk

Describe any risk, migration concern, deployment concern, or follow-up work.
